query: Our Go CLI takes a noticeable moment even for --version. Why is it slow to start?
expected_behavior: Builds the CLI and, after the user agrees, runs initblame.go in run mode with --version and --dir
Opens the init code of each listed package and names what it does at init
Says which import from the user's module brings each slow package in, and suggests sync.OnceValue or moving the import

query: Cold starts of our Lambda got slower after we upgraded dependencies. Here are inittrace logs from before and after.
expected_behavior: Runs initblame.go with --base on the before trace and the after trace
Reports the new or slower packages and their modules
Says that init clock is only part of a cold start

query: initblame shows a package went from 1.2 ms to 1.5 ms. Is that a regression?
expected_behavior: Explains that changes this small are within run-to-run noise
